x: LONDON ORATORY---New member Len Hobbs finished 3rd in the School Championships at both 440yds and 100 metres hurdles, recording 63.1 and 19.1 respectively.
Backing up Simon were:- 40th, Dave Harvey (15m. 43s.); 66th, Len Hobbs (16m. 45s.); 67th Reg Hopkins (16m. 46s.); John Cambridge 84th in 18m. 09s.; and Tony Holmes, who clocked 20m. 34s.
Shields Cup in the youths' section was Mick Marshall, with 96 points, ahead of L.
